feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Teen kills 4 at Oregon school. And, DOJ sues California over alleged noncitizens
entry.summary: A teen opened fire at an Oregon elementary school, leaving three kids and one teacher dead. And, the Justice Department is suing California over alleged noncitizen voters.

entry.title: 3 children, teacher killed in shooting at Oregon elementary school
entry.summary: Three children and a teacher were killed in a shooting at a Bend, Oregon, elementary school Thursday. Officials say a bystander confronted and fatally shot the 16-year-old suspected shooter.

entry.title: Former mayor of Bend, Oregon, on the deadly shooting at an elementary school
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to Jeff Eager, former mayor of Bend, Oregon, about the elementary school shooting in his neighborhood.

entry.title: Security expert discusses deadly Oregon school shooting
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks security expert Juliette Kayyem of Harvard's Kennedy School about the shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon.

entry.title: How much money has Musk given to Republican groups since July? The quiz knows
entry.summary: Plus, this week saw comings and goings at the White House, the revenge of a child (reality) star, and Elon Musk doing Elon Musk things.

entry.title: A rare family of barn owls moved into Manhattan's Upper West Side. New Yorkers are captivated
entry.summary: Manhattan's Upper West Side has been reveling in the company of its latest celebrities: A family of barn owls nested in a water tower atop a building near Central Park.

entry.title: The planned public execution has been canceled, but what message did it send?
entry.summary: President Trump announced that the Fort Hood attacker's execution will not be livestreamed. NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with New Yorker journalist Dexter Filkins, who witnessed a public execution.

entry.title: U.S. historic preservation law faces the most serious threat in its 60-year history
entry.summary: Congress and a federal agency are threatening to weaken the country's historic preservation law, fueling a backlash that critics say is as fiery as the one that led to the law's creation 60 years ago.

entry.title: Trump cancels public execution, but a line may already have been crossed
entry.summary: Defense Secretary Hegseth's announcement of a livestreamed execution elicited reactions of disgust and condemnation from some faith leaders and politicians. But within his church, it's not an outlier.

entry.title: LA fire survivors face another setback with FEMA program delays
entry.summary: The fight over a FEMA program aiding some of LA's most vulnerable wildfire victims is the latest setback for hundreds of fire survivors who still haven't rebuilt after the deadly 2025 infernos.
